architecture_name: Enterprise Jira Blocked-Status Escalation & Rovo AI Triage Spec
author: Samuel Chinwendu Agu - Lead Technical Consultant & Solutions Architect
platform: Atlassian Cloud (Jira + Confluence + JSM + Atlassian Rovo + Atlassian Guard)

governance_controls.identity_and_security: Atlassian Guard (SAML SSO + Enforced 2FA + SCIM Lifecycle Provisioning)
governance_controls.subscription_tier_target: Premium / Enterprise (99.9%+ Uptime SLA, Unlimited Storage, Sandbox + Release Tracks)

trigger.jql_filter: project IN ('ENG', 'OPS') AND sprint IN openSprints() AND status = 'Blocked' AND updated <= -24h

conditions: Custom Field 'Accountable Owner (RACI)' IS NOT EMPTY
actions: Add automated comment tagging {{issue.Accountable Owner}} and {{issue.project.lead}} requesting root-cause unblock ETA
Link issue via Smart Link to Confluence RAID Log page

automation_rules.rule_name: Rovo Agent Backlog Readiness & Release Notes Skill
automation_rules.permission_boundary: Strictly enforces underlying Jira and Confluence user permission schemes
automation_rules.human_in_the_loop_gate: Write/Mutate actions require explicit user confirmation on Action Card before modifying Jira fields
